KHOU 11 (Houston) is your source for breaking news, Texas weather, traffic, and live coverage in Houston and across Southeast Texas. Get the latest updates from the KHOU team — from major local headlines and investigations to severe weather, community stories, and the moments everyone’s talking about.
Watch live newscasts, stream breaking coverage, and catch up on the top stories shaping Houston, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Galveston, and surrounding communities.

Subscribe for:
• Houston breaking news + live updates
• Texas weather forecasts, storms, and severe weather alerts
• Investigations and accountability reporting
• Community stories across Southeast Texas
• Major events, sports, and local explainers

KHOU — Houston news and weather, live and on demand.

🔗 More: https://www.khou.com
